components.name: IconButton
components.description: Icon-only button: a square FIXED frame (36/44/52) with a centred Phosphor glyph (16/20/24), padding 0. 3 Sizes x 3 Variants = 9 variants; hover/pressed/focus-visible/disabled are interaction-only (0.3). WHY padding 0 and a FIXED square: expressing the centring as padding needs 10/12/14 which are not spacing tokens (2.3). WHY Outline carries color/bg/surface rather than no fill: its primary use is the wishlist button over a product photo, where a transparent circle disappears (2.4). WHY Filled is radius/lg while Outline/Ghost are radius/full: binding decision 1 (buttons are radius/lg, not pills) applies to the brand-filled form so a Filled IconButton beside a Button Variant=Primary shares its corner; the halo forms (Outline/Ghost) stay circular per 2.3 because a circular hover halo is the universal icon-button affordance and the Outline circle is what reads over photography. Exposed properties (exact names, for the overlays that nest this set): icon (INSTANCE_SWAP, default icon/x, bound to layer 'icon'), ariaLabel (TEXT, default 'Close', bound to _aria-label), focusVisible (BOOLEAN, default false, bound to _focus), loading (BOOLEAN, default false, bound to _spinner). Nesting recipe: dismiss controls in Modal/Drawer/Toast/Alert use Variant=Ghost Size=Medium with icon=icon/x and ariaLabel 'Close'/'Dismiss'; Pagination arrows use Variant=Outline Size=Medium with icon/caret-left and icon/caret-right. Size=Small is FORBIDDEN on storefront mobile (2.7); it is permitted in admin table rows and toolbars with space/2 separation and carries _hit44. loading: the _spinner wrapper (host-coloured backing on Filled/Outline) covers the glyph, so one property toggle produces a correct loading state; it never leaves an empty box (2.8). Disabled per binding decision 6: fill color/bg/disabled, glyph color/text/disabled, Outline border color/border/default; Ghost keeps no fill. A11y: <button> with a REQUIRED aria-label (CI fails without it); toggle buttons (wishlist) use aria-pressed and announce 'Added to wishlist' through the page live region, never a changed aria-label; loading sets aria-busy=true. Bangla: no visible text, no reflow; the ariaLabel MUST be translated for every one of the 14 icon-button usages (close, remove, wishlist, share, zoom, previous, next, menu, search, filter, sort, edit, delete, copy) - a missing Bangla row fails the i18n lint (2.6). Must never: carry a text label, be used at Size=Small on storefront mobile, be built with a stroke on the Phosphor glyph, or be stretched to FILL.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Five-star rating in two modes. Mode=Display is the read-only aggregate (stars -> numeric -> count, left to right in both scripts); Mode=Interactive is the review-form input (five abutting 44x44 radio cells, whole stars only). 2 Modes x 3 Sizes = 6 variants; Mode=Interactive Size=Small is built for matrix completeness and is marked _invalid on the board (18.3). WHY value is not an axis: 11 half-step values x 6 would be 66 combinations for dynamic data; the fill is a per-star clip mask (0%/50%/100% of the glyph) set per instance (18.5). THE HALF-STAR RULE: stars are quantised to the NEAREST HALF (Math.round(v*2)/2: 4.3 -> 4.5 stars, 4.24 -> 4.0); the printed number is the UNROUNDED value to one decimal, always with the decimal (4.0 never 4). The number is the truth, the stars are a +/-0.25 glance; rounding the number to match the stars inflates the rating, flooring the stars under-reports it. Partial values other than halves are never rendered. WHY the filled star has a mandatory 1px color/border/strong outline: color/bg/accent on color/bg/surface is 1.9:1, below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 for a meaningful graphic; outline + the adjacent empty-star shapes + the always-present numeric value together carry the meaning, which is why showNumeric defaults to true and the accessible name always states the number (18.4). Count: parenthesised with no space ('4.3 (128)'), comma-grouped at 1,000+ ('(1,284)'), never abbreviated to k (meaningless in Bangla), color/text/secondary one weight lighter than the number; on the PDP the whole group is an in-page anchor to #reviews and only the Count goes color/text/link + underline on hover; on ProductCard it is PLAIN TEXT because the whole card is one link and a nested anchor is invalid HTML (18.6). Zero reviews: showEmpty=true shows five empty stars + 'No reviews yet' in color/text/tertiary at the SAME row height - never '0.0', never a hidden row (hiding it changes card height between grid items, a CLS defect). On a 171px card the Bangla empty string does not fit beside stars, so the card sets showStars=false and uses the shortened string (18.9). Interactive: <fieldset><legend>Your rating</legend> + five visually-hidden radios, arrow keys move+select, Home/End jump, one tab stop, native required; hover previews fill 1..n via a star-shaped _scrim at 8%; the _focus ring sits around the FOCUSED STAR'S 44px cell at radius/md, not the group; no Clear control; fill crossfades over fast 120ms, no bounce/scale/burst, reduced motion = instant (18.7). Bangla: GROW, no wrap; numerals Western in the visible glyphs (the rating sits 8px from the price). A11y: visible glyphs are aria-hidden; the group's accessible name is composed in full ('Rated 4.3 out of 5 from 128 reviews'; singular 'from 1 review'). Must never: render a single star with a number, show (0), truncate the empty text, animate with spring, or let the number disagree with the stars by more than the half-step quantisation.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Non-interactive linear progress indicator with an optional header row (label + value) above a FILL-width track. 2 Variants x 2 Sizes x 2 Tones = 8 variants; no interaction states (31.4). Determinate: Indicator is FIXED width x FILL height inside a clipping radius/full Track; its width is an INSTANCE RESIZE (Figma has no numeric property that drives a child's percentage), built at 64% with reference instances at 0/1/50/99/100 on the board. Indicator min-width 8 so 1% is visible rather than a sliver; exactly 0% is width 0 (Indicator hidden), because nothing started means nothing shown (31.3). Indeterminate: Indicator is 40% of the track and sweeps translateX(-100% -> 250%) over 1600ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite, transform only; the manifest ships the mid-sweep resting frame. REDUCED MOTION: the sweep is replaced by a static FULL-WIDTH color/bg/brand-subtle fill (not slowed, not hidden) - a 1600ms sweep across a full-width bar is exactly the large-area horizontal motion most likely to provoke vestibular symptoms, and unlike the 20px Spinner a sensible static state exists; this is why showLabel is MANDATORY on Indeterminate - removing the motion must remove no information (31.5). Determinate motion: width transition base 200ms standard; reduced motion = instant; NEVER animated up from 0 on mount - a bar that fills from zero on every page load is a lie about progress. WHY Tone=Success exists: one case, the free-delivery meter turning green when the threshold is met; without it that state would be an instance colour override, which is the drift this system prevents. Tone=Success also shows a 16px icon/check in color/status/in-stock before the label so the change is never colour-only (31.6, 31.10). No Tone=Accent: 1.8:1 against the track fails 1.4.11; Brand is 4.3:1 and Success 3.6:1. Free-delivery meter: Size=Small, showLabel=true, showValue=false (the remaining amount is the information, a percentage is not); label '৳450 more for free delivery' -> 'You have free delivery'; capped at 100%; NO celebration on reaching the threshold - the cart is a money surface; the label is the aria-live=polite region, debounced 500ms. A11y: role=progressbar on the Track with aria-valuemin/max/now on Determinate and ALL THREE OMITTED on Indeterminate (an omitted aria-valuenow is what says 'indeterminate'; 0 says 'no progress'); aria-labelledby the visible label or aria-label when hidden - a bar with no accessible name is a defect; aria-valuetext wherever the raw number is not the meaning ('450 taka more for free delivery'); the progressbar element itself is never a live region. pointer-events none, no tab stop, never a seek control; a cancellable operation pairs it with a separate Button Variant=Ghost 'Cancel'. Bangla: label WRAPS to 2 lines at Bangla/Mobile/body-sm (24.2px/line); Header is HUG so the component grows by ~24px; track height and indicator percentage are unaffected; label cap 56 Bangla characters. Must never: animate from 0 on mount, use spring easing, animate width/background-position on Indeterminate, set aria-valuenow=0 for indeterminate, be used as a seek control, or use color/bg/accent as a tone.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Rating/Value-sm
newTextStyles.why: Spec 18.3 wants en/caption 12/500 for the Small numeric. Latin/Mobile/caption matches size and weight but the three Rating value styles all carry tabular figures (tnum) so that '4.3' and '4.1' occupy the same advance width and the Count sits at the same x across every card in a grid; one rule for all three sizes rather than a caption exception.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Rating/Value-md
newTextStyles.why: Spec 18.3: en/body-sm 14 / 600. No existing 14px style is 600 (Latin/Mobile/body-sm and Latin/Desktop/body-sm are 14/400; body-strong is 15/16; label is 13). 150% line box = 21px inside the FIXED 24 row.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Rating/Value-lg
newTextStyles.why: Spec 18.3: en/body 16 / 700. Latin/Desktop/body is 16/400, Latin/Mobile/h4 is 16/600, Latin/Stepper/Value is 16/700 but at 130% and owned by QuantityStepper (04 manifest restricts it to that component). 150% = 24px inside the FIXED 32 row.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/Rating/Count-sm
newTextStyles.usedBy: Rating Size=Small, layers Meta/Count and Meta/Empty
newTextStyles.why: Spec 18.3/18.4: the count is 12 / 400, one weight lighter than the 500 numeric. The only 12px style, Latin/Mobile/caption, is 500, so the weight contrast the spec relies on ('the count is context; the score is the headline') would be lost. Medium and Large counts use the existing Latin/Mobile/body-sm (14/400).

newTextStyles.name: Latin/ProgressBar/Label
newTextStyles.why: Spec 31.3: en/body-sm 14 / 1.5 / 500. Latin/Mobile/body-sm and Latin/Desktop/body-sm are 14/400; Latin/Field/Label belongs to form fields and is 600 per spec 3.3. A 500 label is what separates the progress label from body copy without making it a heading.

newTextStyles.name: Latin/ProgressBar/Value
newTextStyles.why: Spec 31.3: en/caption 12 / 1.4 / 600 with tabular-nums. Latin/Mobile/caption is 12/500 and proportional. tnum is MANDATORY here: without it the label's available width changes as the percentage goes 9% -> 10% -> 100%, which is the exact jitter the 40px min-width exists to prevent.

notes: CONVENTION / this manifest uses the brief's frame-descriptor keys directly: clipsContent, primaryAxisAlign, counterAxisAlign, minWidth, opacity. Constraints are given as Figma API values {horizontal, vertical} in MIN | CENTER | MAX | STRETCH | SCALE (MIN = Left/Top, MAX = Right/Bottom). absolute.inset uses null for an unconstrained edge; negative values sit outside the parent.

CONVENTION / bindTo arrays: not needed in this batch - every property drives exactly one layer. Where the spec asked one boolean to drive two layers in OPPOSITE directions (IconButton.loading = spinner on + icon off; Rating.showEmpty = empty on + numeric/count off) Figma cannot invert, so the manifest binds the positive direction only and documents the second step (see the IconButton loading and Rating showEmpty notes).

CONVENTION / `cornerRadiusPx` appears exactly once: on IconButton Variant=Filled's _focus ring (20). It is the one place a radius cannot be a token (see the IconButton _focus note). `cornerRadiusToken: null` on the same layer means no token is bound. Everywhere else radius is a bound token.

CONVENTION / `fillPercent` (ProgressBar Indicator) and `maskFraction` (Rating Star-N) are DOCUMENTATION fields, not Figma properties: they record the percentage the shipped px width represents so the lead can recompute size.w when the parent width changes. Ignore them when creating nodes.

CONVENTION / documentationInstances: `overrides` are component-property values (setProperties); `layerEdits` are direct edits to layers that NO property owns (resize, visibility of unbound layers, characters of unbound text, fill swaps for disabled). `Star-{1..5}` means apply to all five. `size.w` means resize width only; `absolute.inset.l` means move the absolute child's x.

CONVENTION / _aria-label and _aria-legend text layers: 1x1, textAutoResize NONE, fillToken null, LAYER OPACITY 0, absolute at inset 0,0 constraints MIN/MIN, text style Latin/Mobile/caption (any style; it never renders). 04 convention retained.

CONVENTION / every structural container (IconButton _spinner wrapper on Ghost, Rating root, Stars, Star-N, _fill-mask, Meta, ProgressBar root, Header) has fillToken null. The ONLY surfaces with a fill are: IconButton root (Filled/Outline), IconButton _spinner backing (Filled/Outline), ProgressBar Track and Indicator, and the star glyphs themselves.

TOKEN REMAP / spec spacing/1 -> space/1 (4), spacing/2 -> space/2 (8). Radius names bound as named: radius/md (12), radius/lg (16), radius/full. Stroke weights: border-width/hairline (1) on star outlines, border-width/control (1.5) on IconButton Outline, border-width/strong (2) on every _focus.

OPTIONAL SIZE-TOKEN BINDINGS / IconButton frames 36/44/52 may bind size/control-sm / size/control-md / size/control-lg; glyphs 16/20/24 may bind size/icon-sm / size/icon-md / size/icon-lg; the 44 of every _hit44 and Rating interactive cell may bind size/touch-min; ProgressBar LabelIcon 16 may bind size/icon-sm. Do NOT bind the star glyphs (14/18/24 are Rating-specific - 24 coinciding with size/icon-lg is accidental), the ProgressBar track heights (4/8) or the 40px Value min-width.

CONFLICT / IconButton radius. Spec 2.3 gives radius/full for all 9 variants. Binding decision 1 (buttons are radius/lg, not pills) plus the lead's instruction ('radius/lg for the brand-filled variant if it has one, otherwise what section 2 states') is applied as: Variant=Filled -> radius/lg; Variant=Outline and Variant=Ghost -> radius/full. Reason recorded in the set description: Filled sits beside Button Variant=Primary and must share its corner; the halo forms are circles because the circular hover halo is the universal icon-button affordance and the Outline circle is what reads over product photography. The _scrim on each variant binds the SAME radius token as its host.

CONFLICT / IconButton disabled tokens. Spec 2.4 disabled rows say color/bg/subtle + color/text/tertiary. Binding decision 6 wins: color/bg/disabled + color/text/disabled, Outline border -> color/border/default at the unchanged 1.5 (border-width/control) so the outer size does not shift, Ghost keeps fillToken null (2.4's 'None' for Ghost disabled is preserved - a disabled Ghost gaining a grey plate would look like a disabled Filled). Disabled is an instance-level token override (documentation instance 'IconButton / disabled'), not a variant; it also hides _scrim and never shows _focus (a real disabled attribute leaves the tab order).

CONFLICT / numerals in Bangla strings. Spec 18.9 puts BENGALI numerals in the Rating accessible name ('১২৮টি রিভিউ থেকে ৫-এ ৪.৩ রেটিং') and spec 31.8 puts Bengali digits in prose counts ('১২টির মধ্যে ৩টি ছবি'). Binding decision 8 (Western 0-9 in both locales) wins in this manifest: every Bangla documentation string here uses Western digits ('48টি অর্ডারের...', '128টি রিভিউ থেকে 5-এ 4.3 রেটিং'). FLAG FOR THE LEAD: manifest 04 (Stepper reason line) applied the opposite rule from the same spec ('Do not fix it'), so the library currently carries both conventions; the owner should rule once. The spec's screen-reader argument for the ARIA string (a Bangla voice reads Western digits in English) is real and is the strongest case for an exception - record it, do not silently decide it.

CONFLICT / ProgressBar `label` is NOT a TEXT property (spec 31.2 lists one). Binding decision 3: the default differs per variant - 'You have free delivery' on Tone=Success (with the check glyph) versus '৳450 more for free delivery' on Tone=Brand - and a single set-wide default would print the Brand copy on the green bar, which is incoherent on the set and exactly what decision 3 forbids. Header/Label is therefore per-variant characters, edited directly on instances (legal because no property owns it). showLabel, valueText and showValue ARE properties because their values are uniform.

CONFLICT / ProgressBar showLabel default is TRUE (spec 31.2 says false). Reasons: (1) showLabel binds to the Header FRAME, not the Label text, because a Header whose children are all hidden would still occupy the root's space/2 gap and leave an 8px phantom above the track - binding the frame is the only way a label-less bar is pixel-exact; (2) spec 31.5 makes the label MANDATORY on Indeterminate and 31.6 on the free-delivery meter, so true is the safe default; (3) a visible header on the set is what lets reviewers see the per-variant label and the Bangla wrap. Consequence: showLabel=false also hides the Value (a value with no label has no accessible name and no meaning). In code the two props stay independent.

CONFLICT / ProgressBar `fillWidth` TEXT property (spec 31.2, 'documentation only') is DROPPED. An unbound component property shows in the instance panel and does nothing, which misleads; the indicator width is an instance resize and the five reference instances (0/1/50/99/100) document the edge cases instead. The `fillPercent` documentation field on each Indicator records the shipped percentage.

CONFLICT / ProgressBar `showLabelIcon` is NOT a property. The 16px icon/check (color/status/in-stock) before the label is intrinsic to Tone=Success (31.6, 31.10 'Tone=Success adds a check glyph as well as the colour change'), so Header/LabelIcon is visible per variant: true on both Tone=Success variants, false on Tone=Brand (where it ships as icon/check in color/text/secondary so toggling it on an instance shows something sane). Not property-bound (binding decision 3).

CONFLICT / Rating star outline vs the Phosphor fills-only rule. Spec 18.4 MANDATES a 1px color/border/strong stroke on the filled star and 1px color/border/default on the empty star (accent on surface is 1.9:1). The brief's 'never stroke a Phosphor icon' rule exists to stop Lucide stroke-weights being copied; this stroke is a deliberate 1.4.11 outline, so it is applied - but ON THE VECTOR PATH INSIDE THE ICON INSTANCE (stroke align INSIDE), never on the instance frame (a frame stroke would draw a square). border-width/hairline bound. The Interactive _scrim star carries NO stroke.

CONFLICT / Rating gap structure. Spec 18.8 draws a flat root (Stars, Numeric, Count, Empty) with root gap spacing/2, but 18.3 wants Stars->Numeric = 8 and Numeric->Count = 4 - two gaps in one auto-layout row is impossible. Resolution: Numeric, Count and Empty live in a `Meta` frame (HUG x HUG, gap space/1, counter CENTER); root gap space/2. Widths are unchanged: Medium = 106 + 8 + (26 + 4 + 34) = 178, matching 18.3 exactly. Property paths are therefore Meta/Numeric, Meta/Count, Meta/Empty.

CONFLICT / Rating showNumeric/showCount defaults 'true (Display), false (Interactive)' (18.2) cannot exist - one default per set. Resolution: Meta (Numeric/Count/Empty), _hit44 and _aria-label exist ONLY in the three Mode=Display variants; Interactive variants carry Stars + _aria-legend. showNumeric/showCount/showEmpty/showStars/value/count/emptyText/ariaLabel default to the Display values and simply have no target in Interactive (same mechanism as Divider.showLabel on Vertical). focusVisible has a target only in Interactive.

CONFLICT / Rating ariaLabel on Interactive. The Display accessible name ('Rated 4.3 out of 5 from 128 reviews') and the Interactive legend ('Your rating') differ per variant, so the TEXT property ariaLabel binds only to the Display variants' _aria-label; Interactive variants carry an UNBOUND _aria-legend text layer with per-variant characters 'Your rating' (Bangla: 'আপনার রেটিং'), edited directly on instances. In code: Display = aria-label on the group; Interactive = <legend>.

RATING / showEmpty needs THREE property writes on an instance (showEmpty=true, showNumeric=false, showCount=false) because a boolean cannot hide other layers. In code it is one prop. The five _fill-mask layers are also hidden by direct edit for the empty state (see the Bangla documentation instance).

RATING / the shipped Display value is 4.3 -> stars quantised to 4.5: Star-1..4 _fill-mask at 100% (width = glyph), Star-5 at 50% (width = glyph/2: 7 / 9 / 12). A 0% star is `_fill-mask` visible:false - Figma cannot create a 0-wide frame, and a hidden mask is the honest 0. The mask is CLIP CONTENT = TRUE, fill null, anchored at the glyph's left edge with the full-size _filled star at (0,0) inside it, so 50% clips exactly half of the icon box; Phosphor's star is symmetric about its vertical axis and centred in its box, so half the box IS half the glyph's advance (the 18.5 off-centre warning does not bite with this glyph).

RATING / the shipped Interactive state is a committed value of 4 (Star-1..4 at 100%, Star-5 hidden) so the filled-star construction is reviewable on the set itself; the true initial form state (unset, five empty stars) is the documentation instance 'Rating / interactive unset'. Interactive renders WHOLE stars only - never set a 50% mask on an Interactive instance.

RATING / Star cell geometry. Display: Star-N is a FIXED glyph x glyph plain frame (14/18/24) with _empty and _fill-mask at (0,0). Interactive: Star-N is FIXED 44x44, the glyph is centred by offset (44 - glyph)/2 = 15 / 13 / 10 on both axes, cells abut at gap 0 (Stars gap 0) giving the 220 total; this abutting is permitted because the cells are mutually exclusive radios in one group (18.10). Stars frame gap for Display: space/1 at Small/Medium, space/2 at Large.

RATING / Interactive layer order inside Star-N (bottom to top): _empty -> _fill-mask(_filled) -> _scrim -> _focus. _scrim is a star-shaped ICON_INSTANCE (icon/star, fill color/text/primary, layer opacity 0, no stroke) rather than a rectangle so the hover preview darkens the glyph, not the 44px cell; hover sets 8%. Display cells have no _scrim (non-interactive). Every Interactive cell has a _focus (52x52 at inset -4, radius/md, 2px color/border/focus) but ONLY Star-4's is property-bound (focusVisible) - the other four stay unbound and visible:false so a designer can toggle one directly to show focus on a different star. The ring overlaps the neighbouring cells by 4px; that is correct, only one ring is ever visible.

RATING / _hit44 on Display variants: a RECTANGLE spanning the full group width x 44, fill null, absolute, constraints STRETCH/CENTER, inset t/b = -(44 - row)/2 (Small -12, Medium -10, Large -6), visible:false, NOT a property. Toggle it visible only on a LINKED Display rating (the PDP #reviews anchor, 18.10); on ProductCard the rating is plain text inside the card link and the rectangle stays hidden.

RATING / row heights are FIXED (20 / 24 / 32 Display, 44 Interactive) so a rated row and an empty row are the same height - the alignment guarantee for product grids. Bangla line boxes at x1.15: Small 19.3 in 20, Medium 24.15 in 24 (0.15px overshoot, clipsContent is false so nothing clips - accepted), Large 27.6 in 32. Nothing wraps; strategy GROW.

RATING / text styles: Numeric binds Latin/Rating/Value-sm|md|lg (new, tnum); Count binds Latin/Rating/Count-sm at Small and Latin/Mobile/body-sm at Medium/Large (Mobile rather than Desktop because the rating's canonical surfaces, ProductCard and PDP, are mobile-first; both body-sm styles are 14/150% so geometry is identical); Empty binds the same style as Count at each size (spec is silent; the empty text replaces Numeric+Count and reads as context, so it takes the context weight). Count hover (linked only): color/text/link + underline - prototype/code only.

RATING / Count rules carried into content: '(128)' no space before the bracket; '(1,284)' comma-grouped, never '(1.3k)'; '(1)' stays '(1)' with the accessible name going singular 'from 1 review'; zero reviews hides the Count entirely and shows emptyText - '(0)' is never shown.

ICONBUTTON / auto-layout (all 9): HORIZONTAL, FIXED x FIXED (36/44/52), primary CENTER, counter CENTER, padding 0, gap 0, CLIP CONTENT = FALSE (the _focus ring and Small's _hit44 sit outside). Layer order bottom to top: _scrim (absolute) -> icon -> _spinner (absolute, centred) -> _aria-label (absolute) -> [_hit44 on Size=Small] -> _focus (absolute). _hit44 is inserted before _focus so the spec's 2.5 order is preserved for the five named layers.

ICONBUTTON / loading. `loading` binds _spinner.visible. _spinner is a WRAPPER FRAME at the glyph size (16/20/24), centred absolutely, containing a Spinner instance (Size=Small/Medium/Large to match 16/20/24 per spec 14.3; Tone=OnBrand on Filled, Tone=Neutral on Outline and Ghost per 1.6/14.4). The wrapper carries a BACKING FILL equal to the host surface - color/bg/brand on Filled, color/bg/surface on Outline - so when it appears it fully covers the glyph and one property toggle yields a correct loading state (Figma cannot bind the same boolean to hide `icon`). On Ghost the backing is null (the host has no fill to match), so the lead ALSO hides the unbound `icon` layer on a loading Ghost instance - a legal direct override. Spec 2.2's 'icon hidden' is thereby met on every variant.

ICONBUTTON / _focus radius. Outline and Ghost hosts are radius/full -> _focus binds radius/full (0.2). The Filled host is radius/lg (16) -> the ring must be 16 + 4 = 20 to stay concentric, and no radius token is 20 (xl is 24). The manifest gives cornerRadiusPx 20, a raw value forced by the 0.2 arithmetic. LEAD: match whatever the existing Button set's _focus uses for its radius/lg host so the two sets agree; if Button used radius/xl, use radius/xl here too and accept the 4px non-concentricity.

ICONBUTTON / Size=Small _hit44: RECTANGLE 44x44, fill null, absolute at inset -4 on all sides (36 + 8 = 44), constraints CENTER/CENTER, visible TRUE (always applies at this size), NOT a property. It coincides in position with the _focus ring's box but is square and unstroked. Size=Small is forbidden on storefront mobile (2.7); admin toolbars separate adjacent Small buttons by space/2 so hit areas never overlap (0.8).

ICONBUTTON / interaction states (not axes, binding decision 5). Filled: hover _scrim 8%, pressed _scrim 12% + scale(.98). Outline: hover FILL SWAP to color/bg/subtle (no scrim), pressed color/bg/subtle + _scrim 8%. Ghost: hover fill swap to color/bg/subtle and glyph -> color/text/primary, pressed + _scrim 8%. Focus-visible: focusVisible=true. Transitions fast 120ms standard; spring is forbidden. The _scrim fill is color/text/primary at layer opacity 0 in all 9 variants, radius = host radius.

ICONBUTTON / icon default is icon/x (2.2), not the 0.9 generic icon/circle, because the dominant nested use (Modal/Drawer/Toast/Alert dismiss) is a close glyph. INSTANCE_SWAP binds the `icon` layer's mainComponent; the lead's Lucide->Phosphor map for the 14 usages: x->x, trash-2->trash, heart->heart, share->(request if needed), zoom-in->magnifying-glass, chevron-left/right->caret-left/caret-right, menu->list, search->magnifying-glass, filter->funnel, sort->sliders-horizontal, edit->pencil-simple, copy->(request if needed). No new icons are requested by this manifest; 'share' and 'copy' have no Phosphor component in the file yet and are Tier-2 concerns (share-network, copy).

ICONBUTTON / glyph colour is a FILL on the Phosphor instance (never a stroke): on-brand (Filled), text/primary (Outline), text/secondary (Ghost). Spec 2.3's 'icon stroke 1.75px' is void under binding decision 2.

PROGRESSBAR / auto-layout. Root: VERTICAL, FILL x HUG, gap space/2, padding 0, primary MIN, counter MIN, clipsContent false, reference width 358 (the 390 - 2x16 mobile content width). Header: HORIZONTAL, FILL x HUG, SPACE_BETWEEN, counter CENTER, gap space/2 (children LabelIcon [per-Tone visible] -> Label [FILL x HUG, auto-height, wraps] -> Value [Determinate only]). Track: HORIZONTAL, FILL x FIXED 4|8, color/bg/subtle, no stroke, radius/full, CLIP CONTENT = TRUE (masks the indicator's radius at both ends and clips the indeterminate sweep), primary MIN, counter CENTER. Indicator (Determinate): FIXED 229 x FILL, radius/full, min-width 8, fill color/bg/brand | color/status/in-stock.

DERIVE: ProgressBar Determinate Indicator width = round(fillPercent/100 x live Track width), floored at 8 when fillPercent > 0 and HIDDEN when fillPercent = 0. The shipped 229 is 64% of the 358 reference; when the lead places an instance at another width (admin 1024 card, 390 mobile) recompute from the Track's absoluteBoundingBox - never keep 229.

DERIVE: ProgressBar Indeterminate Indicator is ABSOLUTE (constraints SCALE / STRETCH) at inset l = 30% of the live Track width (107 at 358) with width 40% of the live Track width (143 at 358) and height = track. This is the MID-SWEEP resting frame of translateX(-100% -> 250%), chosen so a reviewer sees the indicator inside the track rather than clipped at an edge. Recompute both from the Track's absoluteBoundingBox when the width changes; SCALE constraints keep the proportion if the instance is resized afterwards.

PROGRESSBAR / Value layer: text HUG x HUG with MIN WIDTH 40 and text align RIGHT, Latin/ProgressBar/Value (12/600/tnum), color/text/secondary, visible false (showValue). Hug-with-min-width rather than FIXED 40 so a count-style value ('3 of 12') can exceed 40 without clipping while '0%'..'100%' all sit in exactly 40. Only Determinate variants have this layer; Indeterminate has no percentage (no aria-valuenow) so valueText/showValue have no target there.

PROGRESSBAR / per-variant label text (unbound): Determinate+Brand '৳450 more for free delivery' (196px, 1 line); Determinate+Success 'You have free delivery' (168px, 1 line, preceded by the check); Indeterminate+Brand and Indeterminate+Success 'Booking courier for 48 orders — do not close this page' (398px -> 2 lines at 358, so those two variants ship 64|68 tall). Variant=Indeterminate x Tone=Success has NO specified use (31.1 justifies Success only for the determinate free-delivery meter); it is built for matrix completeness and reuses the admin bulk-booking copy. Its reduced-motion fallback, by analogy with 31.5, is a full-width color/bg/success-subtle fill - a decision recorded here because the spec is silent.

PROGRESSBAR / sizes shipped (w x h): Determinate Small 358x33, Determinate Medium 358x37, Indeterminate Small 358x54, Indeterminate Medium 358x58 (2-line Latin header 42 + 8 + track). Set grid: place the 8 variants in two rows of four with >= 40px gaps; nothing is absolute outside the root bounds.

MOTION / ProgressBar Determinate: transition width base 200ms standard cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); reduced motion: none; NEVER from 0 on mount. Indeterminate: .progress__indicator--indeterminate { width:40%; animation: indeterminate 1600ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite } @keyframes indeterminate { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 100% { transform: translateX(250%) } } - transform only, never width or background-position. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { animation: none; width: 100%; background: var(--color-bg-brand-subtle) } - a static filled-but-muted track, the opposite of the Spinner decision and matching Skeleton: a 1600ms sweep across a full-width bar is the large-area horizontal motion most likely to provoke vestibular symptoms, and a sensible static state exists. showLabel is MANDATORY on Indeterminate so removing the motion removes no information. Figma ships the resting frame only (binding decision 6).

MOTION / Rating: Interactive fill crossfade fast 120ms, no bounce/scale/burst, reduced motion instant. IconButton: scrim and fill-swap transitions fast 120ms standard, pressed scale(.98), reduced motion drops the scale. Spring cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) is forbidden in all three sets.

A11Y / IconButton: <button type="button" aria-label="..."> - aria-label REQUIRED, CI fails without it; toggle (wishlist) uses aria-pressed, never a swapped aria-label, and announces 'Added to wishlist' via the page live region; loading = aria-busy=true + aria-disabled=true + pointer-events none, fill does NOT change to disabled; disabled = real disabled attribute, out of the tab order, no ring.

A11Y / Rating Display: the visible stars, number and count are aria-hidden; the group carries the composed name 'Rated 4.3 out of 5 from 128 reviews' (singular 'from 1 review'); parentheses are never read. Linked on the PDP: an <a href="#reviews"> around the group, smooth scroll suppressed under reduced motion; on ProductCard NOT a link (nested anchor = invalid HTML = two tab stops per card). Rating Interactive: <fieldset><legend>Your rating</legend> + five <input type=radio> visually hidden with <label> stars; Tab enters at the selected value (star 1 if unset), ArrowLeft/Right move+select, Home/End jump to 1/5, each change announces; required, error text 'Choose a rating from 1 to 5' attached to the fieldset per 8.9; touch commits on tap (no hover preview).

A11Y / ProgressBar: role=progressbar on the Track; Determinate carries aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow (+ aria-valuetext when the number is not the meaning: '450 taka more for free delivery', '3 of 12 images uploaded'); Indeterminate OMITS all three. Name via aria-labelledby -> the visible Label, or aria-label when showLabel=false - never nameless. The LABEL is the aria-live=polite region (debounced 500ms); the progressbar element never is. Any operation over ~10s uses Indeterminate with a label naming the work, not a Spinner.

BANGLA / IconButton: no visible text, no reflow; every ariaLabel is translated (14 usages, 40-60% longer, zero layout consequence) and the i18n lint fails on a missing row. Rating: GROW; stars locale-invariant; Western digits in visible value and count ('4.3', '(1,284)') because the rating sits 8px from the price; emptyText 'এখনও কোনো রিভিউ নেই' (~128px at bn caption) fits the PDP but not a 171px card -> card uses showStars=false + 'এখনও রিভিউ নেই'. ProgressBar: label WRAPS to 2 lines at Bangla/Mobile/body-sm (24.2/line), cap 56 Bangla characters, the bar is locale-invariant; the Bangla documentation instances bind Bangla/Mobile/body-sm on Header/Label (the .lang-bn swap), Western digits throughout per binding decision 8 (see the numerals CONFLICT note).

BUILD ORDER FOR THE LEAD. 1) Create the six new text styles (tnum ON for the three Rating/Value styles and ProgressBar/Value). 2) Build IconButton (9) FIRST - Popover/Modal/Drawer/Toast/Alert/Pagination in manifests 07-10 nest it with the property names icon / ariaLabel / focusVisible / loading; confirm Spinner Size=Small/Medium/Large x Tone=OnBrand/Neutral resolve inside _spinner. 3) Build Rating (6): Display first, then Interactive; verify Medium Display = 178 wide and Interactive = 220 x 44; apply star strokes to the vector inside each icon instance. 4) Build ProgressBar (8); verify Track clipsContent = TRUE and root clipsContent = FALSE; recompute indicator widths from live geometry (DERIVE notes). 5) Place documentation instances. 6) Mark `Rating Mode=Interactive, Size=Small` _invalid on the board.
